# Map libraries

Vendored without modification for reliable core-map loading.

- Leaflet 1.9.4: https://leafletjs.com/ and https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/v1.9.4/LICENSE
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster/tree/v1.5.3

Original source copyright notices are retained. Map tiles are still loaded from
OpenStreetMap; local library hosting does not remove that network requirement.
